review: W Don is by far one of the most consistent IDs in the game when it comes to general damage potential. Her S2 generates a lot of charge for her and her S3 is an envy nuke that can consistently deal over 200 damage. She gets additional bonuses if she has charge stored like coin power on her S1 and S2 as well. She is usually what determines whether or not an ID is part of either S+ or SS. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Telepole - E.G.O. that single handedly makes setups for charge IDs basically a non factor which helps massively in situations where fights want to be finished asap.
